proof.method: Re-read the five edited manuscript files in full and diffed each fix against its primary source: the Linux Foundation x402 Foundation press release (linuxfoundation.org, 2026-07-14, fetched directly and via raw HTML to count members and quote verbatim), the house's own 402index-listing.json record for the paid-ephemeris-gateway, and the PYMNTS/TRM article (2026-09-15); re-scanned for defects the edits introduced, then re-read 06-counting-the-market.md line-by-line against the prior version to confirm only the TRM table row changed. Layout-only re-verification after the book-layout.lua/PDF-template/EPUB-MathML pipeline change: diffed the sold and new PDF text page-by-page (stripping only page numbers, running heads, dot leaders and the build hash) and found only the six pages the numbering and running-head fixes touch changed at all; confirmed by direct byte diff that the EPUB's chapter, nav, css and cover content is identical to the sold EPUB except the build identifier and modified timestamp; rendered the title page, the Contents page, the About opening, the table on 6.2, and the Glossary/References running-head pages at 150dpi with pdftoppm for both editions and inspected them for overflow, stranded labels, broken tables and overlapping text; and opened the EPUB as a zip, confirmed the mimetype entry is first and stored, and checked EPUB/content.opf for schema:accessMode/accessModeSufficient/accessibilityFeature/accessibilityHazard/accessibilitySummary metadata.
